scope: Owned navigation insertions; no claims of independent review of other studies.

insertions.insertion: **Knowledge philosophy: connected proposal and completion assessment, 8 October 2026.** [Shared inquiry and standing](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SHARED-INQUIRY-AND-STANDING.md) answers the preceding frontier through supported scope, different thresholds for investigation and acceptance, differentiated access/affected standing/authority, effective criticism and bounded reopening. The [philosophical synthesis](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/PHILOSOPHICAL-ACCOUNT.md) connects formation, knowledge, G0 and wisdom. [Author counterreview and completion assessment](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/KNOWLEDGE-PHILOSOPHY-COMPLETION.md) complete the defended proposal, while preserving unresolved universal validation, exhaustive philosophy and exclusive necessity. Three scoped primary comparisons; no new theorem, experiment or independent-agent acceptance. The inherited twenty- and eight-theorem packages retain their scope. / **相连候选已完成：**认识范围、参与地位与纠正机制有明确回答；完成的是有辩护的哲学方案，不把更强目标改名为已证。

**知识哲学相连候选 / Connected knowledge philosophy，2026-10-08：** [完整论述](unified-2026-10-05/PHILOSOPHICAL-ACCOUNT.md)汇合形成、内容、根据、共同求知、G0 与智慧；[共享范围与地位](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SHARED-INQUIRY-AND-STANDING.md)回答上一前沿。/ The defended proposal is complete at its stated scope, with three new primary comparisons and substantive author counterreview. No new theorem or experiment; universal validation, exhaustive philosophy and whole-theory necessity remain unestablished. [完成评估 / Assessment](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/KNOWLEDGE-PHILOSOPHY-COMPLETION.md).

**Accountable inquiry scope → differentiated standing → situated wisdom, 8 October 2026.** [The completion-stage knowledge study](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SHARED-INQUIRY-AND-STANDING.md) explains why a whole practical comparison must remain answerable to omitted evidence, dependencies and losses. It distinguishes admission from acceptance and credits affected standing to explicit J3/J4. Three primary comparisons and substantive counterreview constrain the philosophical argument; no new theorem or experiment. [The connected proposal](PHILOSOPHICAL-ACCOUNT.md) is complete as a defended synthesis, with [the stronger claims expressly unsettled](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/KNOWLEDGE-PHILOSOPHY-COMPLETION.md). Existing learning and formal mechanisms remain credited. / 此连接说明正当认识怎样进入整体比较及情境理由，不替代规范前提，也不宣布其他会话的统一基础目标完成。

Knowledge philosophy finish-line request, 8 October 2026: [Ren’s exact continuation](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-knowledge-content-continuation.md#finish-line-request) authorizes pursuing the remaining connection and assessing completion. The [shared-inquiry argument](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SHARED-INQUIRY-AND-STANDING.md), [synthesis](../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/PHILOSOPHICAL-ACCOUNT.md) and [completion judgment](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/KNOWLEDGE-PHILOSOPHY-COMPLETION.md) are AI-authored. [Three scoped primary readings](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/KNOWLEDGE-SOURCES.md#shared-inquiry-standing-and-completion) remain link-only, with no new fieldwork, theorem or attributed user endorsement.

before.title_zh: 知识：推展、风险与求知选择
before.title_en: Knowledge: projection, risk and inquiry priorities
before.claim_zh: 认识由内容、根据及可修订标准形成，并经有根据的关系连续性推展。真、证据和可正当依赖分别说明；事实未辨明仍可能有适切回应，真实调查也可能错失时机。G0 与公开 J1–J4/E 连接求知意义、有界责任、优先次序和结束。
before.claim_en: Formed content, grounds and revisable standards extend through supported relational continuity. Truth, evidence and justified reliance differ; an unresolved fact can coexist with a fitting response, while truthful inquiry can miss its opportunity. G0 and explicit J1–J4/E connect inquiry’s significance to bounded responsibilities, priorities and closure.
before.scope_zh: 第三轮新增8项 Lean 定理／13项声明审计，检查共同适切选择、忠实细化及期限案例；域、要求、真实探测及时间法则提供，抽象存在用经典选择。五项新增原典比较有阅读范围，无实证重复。旧20项定理范围保留；下一连接是共享求知中可能性的正当纳入与不平等接近下的地位。普遍归纳、完备语义与整套理论独有必要性未证。
before.scope_en: Round three adds 8 Lean theorems/13 declaration audits for common choices, faithful refinement and deadline cases. Domain, requirements, truthful probing and timing are supplied; abstract existence uses classical choice. Five new primary comparisons have reading limits; no empirical replication. The earlier 20 theorems retain their scope. Next: warranted inclusion of possibilities and standing under unequal access. General induction, exhaustive semantics and unique whole-theory necessity remain unestablished.

after.title_zh: 知识与生活：相连的哲学候选
after.title_en: Knowing and living: connected philosophical proposal
after.claim_zh: 生成中的认识经内容、实际根据、相关错误及可修订标准形成。共同求知须说明可能性的纳入，并区分有理由查与有理由信、相关接近与受影响地位及决定权限。G0 与公开 J1–J4/E 连接理解、真实损失、有界责任及可纠正的智慧回应。
after.claim_en: Knowing forms through content, actual grounds, relevant error and revisable standards. Shared inquiry must warrant its scope and distinguish grounds to investigate from grounds to believe, as well as relevant access, affected standing and decision authority. G0 and explicit J1–J4/E connect understanding, real losses, bounded responsibility and corrigible wise response.
after.scope_zh: 相连的有辩护候选与作者反审已完成；本轮三项原典比较有阅读范围。没有新定理、实验或独立 agent 验收；继承20项／34项审计与8项／13项审计各保留条件。完成不等于普遍验证、完备意识／语义、一般归纳或整套理论独有必要性已证；其他强目标保持未完成。
after.scope_en: Connected defended proposal and author counterreview complete at their stated scope; three new primary comparisons have reading limits. No new theorem, experiment or independent-agent acceptance. Inherited packages retain 20 theorems/34 audits and 8 theorems/13 audits separately. Universal validation, exhaustive consciousness/semantics, general induction and exclusive whole-theory necessity remain unestablished; stronger objectives are not renamed as completed.
